title: pm(tooling): the contract-review tier moves off the retired Fable model to opus, and the rule gains the case it never had — a tier that is GONE is not a tier that is exhausted
body:
Unblocks: #19542 (open p1, its PR #19517 cannot be reviewed), and every future `domain:spec` and `domain:skills` delivery — the lane owes an at-tier contract review on EVERY round it delivers.

Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01AmH9bKvGoLjiY86Q4Z3og2`, seat post #18917) on 2026-09-21, on the maintainer's ruling below. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The ruling

Asked which tier serves the contract review now that Fable is gone, the maintainer chose **opus**, on this reading of the skill's own ladder: 「floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable」 — with `fable` gone, the ceiling falls to `opus`.

Their words on the situation, verbatim: 「fable 没有了」.

## Why this is not something a seat could decide

| reading | value |
| --- | --- |
| `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:12111` | `export const CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER = 'claude-fable-5-1'` |
| `references/contract-review.md:26` | 按车道:spec 与 skills 席审契约增量;达档席内审,**未达档 ⛔ 不自审,起达档子代理** |
| `references/contract-review.md:60` | 契约复核 ⛔ **不适用额度耗尽豁免降档**:豁免对象是派发,复核 ⛔ 不随派发档位免除 |
| `references/contract-review.md:53` | 起不来即无复核,标签原样、**队列外等档** |

⭐ The written rule covers **额度耗尽** — a tier that is exhausted and will come back. It does ⛔ **not** cover a tier that no longer exists. Two dispatches of one review died on their first request (HTTP 429, 「You've reached your Fable limit」, model `claude-fable-5-1`) before the maintainer confirmed the model is gone. A seat reading 「不许降档」 onto a vanished tier would hold the whole lane forever; a seat picking a replacement on its own would be exactly the silent downgrade that fuse exists to stop. ⇒ it went to the maintainer, and this card carries their answer.

## The deliverable

1. **`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:12111`** — `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` moves to the opus model id. ⛔ Do not invent the string: read the id the harness actually serves and pin it, and ⛔ do not leave a second spelling of the old id anywhere the checkers read.
2. **The skill text that names the ladder** — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and `references/contract-review.md`, wherever 「ceiling fable」 or the fable id appears as a live rule rather than as history. ⚠️ ⛔ Do NOT rewrite records of past rulings that legitimately name fable: a record of what was served then stays true.
3. **A line for the case the rule did not have**: a tier that is *gone* is not a tier that is *exhausted*, and the difference is who may act. ⛔ 额度耗尽 keeps its existing treatment (wait, ⛔ never downgrade); a **retired** tier is a maintainer ruling, ⛔ never a seat's reading.
4. **Self-tests** must pin the new constant and the ladder text together, so the two cannot drift apart again.

⚠️ `.claude/**` is **Tier S**: this PR lands on the owning seat's at-tier review of record, ⛔ no approval is owed and ⛔ no maintainer click is waited for. ALL-not-ANY — one Tier H path would make the whole PR Tier H, so ⛔ do not touch `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/adr/**`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` or published `skills/**` in this diff.

## Acceptance

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test` green with a case that fails if the constant and the skill's ladder text disagree; `check-clause2-carriers --template` prints the unchanged `Served-tier:` contract (the key admits the **constant name**, ⛔ never a model id, and that does not change); and a grep showing no live rule still names the retired id, with a control proving the grep fires.

## 查重词

`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER fable retired` · `contract review tier opus` · `ceiling fable ladder` · `tier gone versus tier exhausted` · `降档保险丝 档位消失`
